# Frank Goortani — Architect.Solutions

> Personal CTO portfolio of Frank Goortani — CTO at FasterOutcomes, AI engineering leader, author of "The Centaur CTO" (2026).

Frank Goortani has been full-time CTO at FasterOutcomes since June 2025, focused on production LLM systems for legal and healthcare workflows, AI governance, and engineering leadership. Previously, he was a Solution Architect at Uber (2021–2025), where he built ELLE, an AI decision engine that cut manual privacy review time by roughly 70% across millions of decisions, and a Software Consultant at The Home Depot Canada, where he led 10+ onshore and 50+ offshore developers on homedepot.ca. 25+ years in software and architecture.

## Pages

- [Home](https://architect.solutions/): About Frank, current work, the book, and contact.
- [The Centaur CTO](https://architect.solutions/book/): Book overview, author, and launch updates.
- [What is a Centaur CTO?](https://architect.solutions/centaur-cto/): Definition, origin (Kasparov's advanced chess), centaur vs. cyborg, what to delegate to AI and what to keep.
- [Writing](https://architect.solutions/writing/): Articles and essays on AI engineering and CTO leadership.

## Book

- "The Centaur CTO: Leading with AI to Be More Human" (2026): A practical leadership guide for CTOs who want better judgment, stronger teams, and more human impact with AI.
